_what_this_is: Hosts that serve files uploaded to a personal file-sharing or paste account.
`url.file-sharing-script` reports a <script src> on any of them: whoever
holds the account can change what every visitor runs, and legitimate
plugins, themes and services do not distribute scripts this way.
A host belongs here only if no legitimate script is served from it. That
rule keeps out two kinds of near miss:
*.blob.core.windows.net). Real vendors ship SDKs from buckets there.
- A service's own embed or SDK host: www.dropbox.com serves Dropbox's
Chooser (dropins.js), pastebin.com/embed_js renders a paste, and
gist.github.com/<user>/<id>.js embeds a gist. Only the raw-file hosts
